# Harbor survey

The Helsinki harbor survey was completed on 2026-10-04. The research team measured 42 kilometres of shoreline using a consistent survey method.

This article explains the field methods and preserves multilingual observations: 中文内容 and coastal measurements. The observations cover the northern and eastern shore with independent checkpoints.

All measurements describe this controlled fixture and do not represent a real-world survey. The tabulated values were reviewed by two researchers before publication.

# Cache API guide

The cache stores successful reads until the configured lifetime ends. Set CACHE\_TTL to 300 seconds for this example. Failures are never inserted into the cache.

```
let result = cache.get("key");
```

## Request options

| Option       | Meaning              |
| ------------ | -------------------- |
| retry budget | Two attempts at most |

When the request times out, the client reports the real status and the caller decides whether to retry. This preserves accurate diagnostics for repeated failures and prevents silent extra requests.

# Unicode discussion

## QUESTION\_MARKER

How should the service handle UTF-8 text that contains Chinese characters and emoji? The stream might end in the middle of a multi-byte character, so the response needs a visible truncation indicator.

## ANSWER\_MARKER

Decode only a complete prefix and preserve the remaining bytes until the next read. 中文内容 must remain intact, and the result should distinguish an incomplete preview from an input error.
